sloka: मायया रमताम् नित्यम् परुषः पिशुनोऽशुचिः ।राज्Jनो भीत स्त्वधर्मात्मा यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-५१॥
transliteration: māyayā ramatām nityam paruṣaḥ piśuno'śuciḥ ।rājJno bhīta stvadharmātmā yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-51॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a person, who is abusive, niggardly, impure, unrighteous and always afraid of being caught by the king, and lives by cheating others, acquires
